highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.148.0 is the first stable v4 release, built on Skia m148 with a reworked singleton lifecycle.
highlights_body: It carries everything from the 4.147 preview line — variable fonts, animated WebP encoding, SKSamplingOptions on surface draws — plus the singleton lifecycle rework, pixel-span fixes, and the promotion of long-obsolete SKPaint text/font members to compile errors. This is a breaking release — read the migration notes below before upgrading.

breaking.title: Legacy SKPaint text and font members are now compile errors
breaking.body: The paint text/font state members that were marked `[Obsolete]` in v3 are now errors, and remaining pre-v4 obsoletes have been trimmed from the reference assembly. Move typeface, text size, hinting and text encoding onto `SKFont` (paired with the `SKCanvas.DrawText(..., SKFont, SKPaint)` overloads) before upgrading.

breaking.title: new SKFont() now has an empty typeface
breaking.body: Upstream m132 removed lazy default-typeface resolution. `new SKFont().Typeface` is now `SKTypeface.Empty` (0 glyphs) instead of resolving the platform default at draw time — `MeasureText` returns 0 and nothing is drawn. Pass an explicit typeface: `new SKFont(SKTypeface.Default)`. Detect unset with `font.Typeface.IsEmpty` instead of `== null`.

breaking.title: new SKPaint().Typeface returns Default instead of null
breaking.body: `new SKPaint().Typeface` is now `SKTypeface.Default` (non-null). Text drawing still works — SkiaSharp seeds a usable default — but `paint.Typeface == null` checks no longer fire. Use `paint.Typeface.IsEmpty`, or drop the null check entirely.

breaking.title: SKTypeface.FromFamilyName returns Default instead of null on Android
breaking.body: Unknown families now return `SKTypeface.Default` on all platforms (previously Android returned `null`). For strict “was the font found?” semantics use `SKFontManager.Default.MatchFamily(name, style)`, which still returns `null` on a miss.

breaking.title: SKStream.Move(long) is obsolete and throws on out-of-range offsets
breaking.body: The `Move(long)` overload is now `[Obsolete]` (warning CS0618) and uses a checked cast — values outside `int` range throw `OverflowException` instead of silently truncating. Call `Move(int)` instead, clamping large offsets as needed.

breaking.title: GRContext.CreateVulkan aborts on Vulkan 1.0 instead of returning null
breaking.body: Skia m139+ requires Vulkan 1.1. Passing a 1.0 instance now calls `SK_ABORT` and terminates the process — it is not an exception. Set `VkApplicationInfo.apiVersion = VK_API_VERSION_1_1` and `GRVkBackendContext.MaxAPIVersion = VK_API_VERSION_1_1`. Leaving `MaxAPIVersion` at `0` is unsafe. Genuinely 1.0-only hardware must fall back to raster.

breaking.title: GRVkBackendContextNative: five fields removed
breaking.body: The interop struct loses `fMinAPIVersion`, `fInstanceVersion`, `fExtensions`, `fFeatures`, and `fOwnsInstanceAndDevice`. Use `fVkExtensions` instead of `fExtensions`; `fDeviceFeatures`/`fDeviceFeatures2` instead of `fFeatures`. The ownership fields have no replacement — delete those assignments.

breaking.title: GrVkYcbcrConversionInfo renamed to GRVkYcbcrConversionInfo
breaking.body: The Vulkan YCbCr conversion info struct now follows the SkiaSharp `GR` casing convention and gains a new `Components` field. The old name, its `IEquatable`/`==`/`!=` operators, and the original struct layout are all gone — update references and rebuild.

breaking.title: SKNativeObject.IgnorePublicDispose is now read-only
breaking.body: The `IgnorePublicDispose` property loses its `protected` setter. Subclasses can no longer flip it at runtime; set the desired value from the constructor path instead.

breaking.title: Assembly version bumped to 4.x
breaking.body: SkiaSharp.dll now reports assembly version 4.148.0.0 (up from 3.119.0.0). Consumers with strong-name binding redirects or hard-coded version checks must update them. Review the API-diff report before upgrading.

bullets.detail: The bundled engine moves from m132 through m147 and lands on m148, folding in two upstream chrome/m147 stability sync merges along the way.

bullets.lead: Variable fonts and color font palettes
bullets.detail: Variable font support lands across SkiaSharp and HarfBuzzSharp, and SKFont/SKTypeface gain color font palette selection and hardened variable-font handling.

Default typeface lookup moves to the managed layer (fixing Android API 36+ crashes), and the Skia shim regains `sk_fontmgr_legacy_create_typeface` so code depending on the legacy factory continues to work.
New overloads accept `SKSamplingOptions` so callers can control the filter and mipmap mode for surface-to-surface draws.

bullets.lead: Animated WebP encoding and zero-copy SKStream.GetData
bullets.detail: `SKWebpEncoder` can now emit animated WebP files from a frame sequence, and `SKStream.GetData()` turns any seekable stream into an `SKData` without an intermediate byte[] copy.

bullets.lead: HBColor struct and missing HarfBuzz wrappers
bullets.detail: HarfBuzzSharp gains a proper `HBColor` struct matching `hb_color_t` and fills in wrappers that had been missing or mis-named.

bullets.lead: SKPixmap/SKBitmap pixel span uses row bytes and correct axis
bullets.detail: `GetPixelSpan` now honours `RowBytes` for stride, and `GetPixelSpan<T>(x, y)` computes the row offset from `Width` instead of `Height` — pixels read from non-tight bitmaps are now correct.

bullets.lead: SKPath finalizer crash when SKPathBuilder is collected first
bullets.detail: A GC ordering bug that could crash on finalization when an `SKPathBuilder` was collected before the `SKPath` it produced is now fixed.

bullets.lead: WinUI Projection DLL not found on .NET 9
bullets.detail: The WinUI Projection assembly is now packaged so .NET 9 consumers can load it without a `DllNotFoundException` at startup.

bullets.lead: Android SKGLView blank after MAUI TabBar switch
bullets.detail: Switching tabs in a MAUI TabBar no longer leaves `SKGLView` blank; the GL surface is correctly re-attached after the view is re-added to the tree.

Process-wide singletons (default typefaces, font managers, ambient contexts) now have a documented lifecycle owned by the managed layer instead of ad-hoc native pinning. Disposal and finalization order are predictable. See the breaking-changes note above.

bullets.lead: Native-compat gate moved to SkiaApi cctor
bullets.detail: The native-library compat check moves off `[ModuleInitializer]` onto the SkiaApi type constructor, running on first API use instead of at module load — this avoids AOT/trim edge cases and makes startup failures easier to diagnose.
Tizen picks up 64-bit native builds and Android-hosted Linux (`linux-bionic`) becomes a first-class native target.
Libraries target the versioned Apple TFMs (26.0) while apps use the unversioned ones, matching current .NET SDK guidance.
.NET 8 is now the minimum for the SkiaSharp WASM runtime asset; older Emscripten native slices are removed.
libexpat 2.8.1, libpng 1.6.58, zlib 1.3.2.1-motley, freetype 2.14.3, libjpeg-turbo 3.1.4.1, and HarfBuzz 14.2.0 all pick up their latest upstream security and bug fixes.

contributor_summaries.ramezgerges: The Skia m132/m147 bumps, variable font support end-to-end, the managed default-typeface fix, the SKPath finalizer crash fix, the SKPaint text/font obsolete-to-error promotion, and the singleton lifecycle rework
contributor_summaries.4Darmygeometry: Linux Bionic native assets and PolySharp-based C# 13 support on legacy TFMs
contributor_summaries.SimonvBez: Fixed SKGLView not rendering after MAUI TabBar tab switches on Android

preview_summaries.v4.147.0-preview.1.1: Preview 1 opened the v4 line: Skia m132 → m133 → m147, variable fonts, color font palettes, SKSamplingOptions on surface draws, the managed default-typeface fix, Tizen x64/arm64, Linux Bionic, and dependency refreshes.
preview_summaries.v4.147.0-preview.2.1: Preview 2 added animated WebP encoding, zero-copy `SKStream.GetData()`, the SKPath finalizer crash fix, and the Apple TFM realignment.
preview_summaries.v4.147.0-preview.3.1: Preview 3 finished the API pass with HBColor and missing HarfBuzz wrappers, dropped WASM builds for pre-.NET 8 Emscripten, and picked up freetype, zlib, and libjpeg-turbo refreshes.
preview_summaries.v4.148.0-rc.1.2: The release candidate landed Skia m148, the singleton lifecycle rework, SKPaint text/font errors, the SKPixmap/SKBitmap pixel-span fixes, the WinUI Projection DLL fix for .NET 9, and expat 2.8.1.

harfbuzz_summary: Bundles HarfBuzz 14.2.0 and carries forward the variable-font, HBColor, and color-palette work from the v4 preview line.
